findings: Integration gap in anvil/runner.py: The quality functions packet_quality_charter_section() and packet_anchor_section() are defined in anvil/quality.py but never called. The packet_step() function (line 456) must call these functions and pass their results to _packet_text(), following the pattern established by packet_design_section, packet_rendered_evidence_section, and packet_knowledge_section.

Missing parameters in _packet_text(): The function signature (line 324) needs quality_charter_section and anchor_section parameters added to match the pattern of other section parameters. Without these, the quality information cannot reach station packets.

Station contract not updated: stations/reviewer-design/PROMPT.md describes only a single-verdict output format with a findings list. Per spec requirements and S1, the prompt must document the dual-section structure (compliance section and separate quality section), the anchor comparison duty, and the requirement to name gap categories by criterion (materials, light, scale, contact).

Output format mismatch: The reviewer-design prompt shows {verdict, findings} but the spec and tests expect {compliance: {verdict, findings}, quality: {verdict, findings, anchor}}. The station's contract must match what the validation functions check (validate_reviewer_quality_section in quality.py:180).

Generating station prompts not updated: Per S4, stations that produce imagery (builder, media-producer, brief-writer per QUALITY_CHARTER.md:70) must verify outputs before review and record comparisons in run evidence. Their prompts in stations/builder/, stations/media-producer/, stations/brief-writer/ need the self-comparison duty added to their contracts.

Run report warning mechanism undefined: S2 requires a visible warning in the run report when a visual run has no anchors. The quality module generates the warning text (quality.py:134) but there's no evidence of integration with the run report generation in runner.py or approver.py.

Decision 0001 composable stations: The implementation correctly defines quality.py as a reusable module following the composable pattern, but the module is orphaned - pipelines will not apply it until runner.py calls its functions. The composition is structurally sound but functionally disconnected.
